recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆體積小的晚期紅血球母細胞，核深染、細胞質量少且持續偏藍（持續性細胞質嗜鹼性），呈微小正母細胞（micronormoblast）樣，並有少數核不規則等輕度紅系異生，旁邊顆粒球系成熟完整。
features: Small erythroblasts (micronormoblasts) with dense pyknotic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Persistent cytoplasmic basophilia in late-stage erythroblasts, indicating defective hemoglobinization
Occasional erythroblasts with irregular nuclear outlines (mild dyserythropoiesis)
Abundant maturing granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with normal granulation
Crenated red cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with abundant maturing granulocytic precursors. The erythroid precursors are small (micronormoblastic) with dense nuclei and scant, ragged cytoplasm that retains basophilia at late stages of maturation, reflecting impaired hemoglobinization. A few erythroblasts show irregular nuclear contours, consistent with mild dyserythropoiesis. Granulocytic maturation appears normal and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with a disorder of heme synthesis or iron utilization such as sideroblastic anemia; an iron stain is required to demonstrate ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Micronormoblasts with ragged basophilic cytoplasm are also typical, but marrow storage iron is absent and ring sideroblasts are not seen.
Thalassemia marrow shows marked erythroid hyperplasia with micronormoblasts but normal to increased iron without ring sideroblasts, and abnormal hemoglobin studies.
MDS shows more pronounced multilineage dysplasia (megaloblastoid change, hypolobated megakaryocytes, hypogranular neutrophils) and clonal genetic abnormalities.
